system.description:
You know how to overcharge your Vehicle's weapon to produce additional damage. As a Swift Action, you can overcharge your Vehicle's energy weapon and deal +1 die of damage on your next attack in the same turn.

However, your weapon loses 1 die of damage on its subsequent attacks and cannot be overcharged again, until a full round passes without the weapon firing.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
